feedback: Your essay addresses a relevant topic, but it requires more careful editing to be persuasive. You have some good ideas about equity and classroom management, but your arguments are often undermined by confusing sentences. For example, in your second paragraph, you mention cyberbullying but then label it as 'useful,' which contradicts your point. Ensure that your evidence directly supports the claim you are making. Additionally, watch out for sentence fragments—some of your sentences are incomplete, which makes your writing harder to follow. Always proofread to ensure that each paragraph has a clear, logical flow. By focusing on connecting your ideas more smoothly and checking your grammar, you will make your position much stronger and more convincing.
